risks_and_mitigations: Concurrent incompatible adapter selection: deterministic artifact-scoped serialization plus conflict error and no partial commit.

Schema drift: validate required columns, nullability, and constraint definitions before artifact access.
Partial primary/embedding registration: validate and commit the complete boot set in one transaction.
Unaudited rebind: require actor, non-empty reason, expected revision, and an EventLedger row in the same transaction.
